newsitem.title: ROMANIA: January-Sept Romanian construction 9.2 pct up.
newsitem.headline: January-Sept Romanian construction 9.2 pct up.

text.p: The value of work in Romania's construction sector rose by 9.2 percent in the first nine months of 1996 from the year-ago period to 8.73 trillion lei, a National Statistics Board report said.
It said private companies took 69.9 percent of January- September construction works, up from 57.9 percent in the same period last year.

Official forecasts say construction is expected to expand by 9.4 percent this year, when it is expected to account for 6.6 percent of Romania's gross domestic product. Last year construction rose by 12.6 percent from 1994. ($=3,508 lei)
